production_soil_score.interpretation: relative GOBLIN production-soil screening index, not observed yield

forestry_score.interpretation: forestry production-context screen only; not an afforestation suitability model

rewetting_score.eligibility_rule: dominant IFS soil code ends with PT or equals CUT
rewetting_score.interpretation: conservative first-stage peat/cutover screen; not parcel-level peat area

envelope_boundary: PotentialRelease != Opportunity != RealisedConversion. Land-use opportunity envelopes overlap and must not be summed across uses.
allocation_boundary: No forest, rewetting, AD-grass, willow, energy-grass or nature hectares are allocated unless explicit study/policy shares are supplied separately.
